items.item: Explains flow versions: saving creates a new version and only one version is active
items.evidence: "Saving a change to an active flow in Flow Builder creates a new version, and that version is inactive." and "Only one version is active at a time. Activating the new one deactivates the old one."

items.item: Tests the new version before activating (Flow test, debug run, or test records in the sandbox)
items.evidence: "Step 3: Test the new inactive version in uat. Activate only after these pass: Flow tests... Debug with a test Lead in rollback mode."

items.item: Keeps the previous version available for rollback, and does not touch production
items.evidence: "Record the rollback version"; "Activate the version number you wrote down. Don't delete it."; "A person moves the flow to production with a change set... This plan doesn't cover production."
